Resolved: Astro 4.x, full stop — no React anywhere. Somesh signed off directly (in place of the pending Nick sign-off), delegating the technical call to Engineering. Jul 29 audit of Dave's actual 7-page handoff found zero external JS libraries, zero npm/build tooling, zero framework fingerprints — every page is plain HTML/CSS + vanilla inline JS (IIFEs, IntersectionObserver, scroll listeners; no import/require anywhere), the same pattern already used in site/index.html. Nothing in the handoff needs client state or SPA routing, so there's no technical case for React; Astro's static-first model and file-based routing are a direct match and replace the interim seams.js nav pattern.
